raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the final analysis step. After the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the death dates (Marshall Neilan died on October 27, 1958, and Joseph H. Lewis died on August 30, 2000), the Planner's "Analysis of Previous Result" incorrectly swapped these dates. The Planner stated that Marshall Neilan died on August 30, 2000, and Joseph H. Lewis died on October 27, 1958. This hallucination/reversal of the data led to the incorrect conclusion that Marshall Neilan (director of *His Last Haul*) died later, when in reality, Joseph H. Lewis (director of *The Falcon In San Francisco*) died later.
